about: The tractus of the formulary “Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Rejoice, Virgin Mary, you who believed the words of the Archangel Gabriel. You alone have put an end to all heresies, as you, a virgin, brought forth God and man and after childbirth remained an inviolate virgin. Mother of God, intercede for us.
